scripts.dev:all: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web,quant -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev:quant"
scripts.dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
